title: The label judge asks the release agent through a request file and records its verdicts strictly
steps: Run the label judge test file of the quickstart tools.
expect: The audit writes a request for uncached slots only; record-judge accepts a complete verdicts file, refuses missing slots, bad roles and unknown keys, and a rerun on unchanged content asks nothing.

tests: the audit calls no model: it writes a request for every located slot without a cached verdict
record-judge takes a complete answer and writes the block Road to live reads
record-judge refuses a missing slot, a bad role, an unknown key and an unknown field, and writes nothing
a rerun on unchanged content asks nothing: the recorded verdicts are the cache
